messages.subject: NTUSO Audition requirements 2026
messages.body_text: NTUSO audition requires G major scale, one prepared piece, sight reading, and arrival 15 minutes early. The audition room is Music Studio 3.

messages.subject: Updated NTUSO Audition schedule
messages.body_text: Updated NTUSO audition schedule: violin candidates should attend on 2026-08-28 at 14:00. Bring student card and printed repertoire list.

messages.subject: ICA Student Pass completion checklist
messages.body_text: Complete the ICA Student Pass formalities with IPA letter, passport, SG Arrival Card, recent photo, and appointment confirmation. Deadline: 2026-08-20.

messages.subject: Course registration deadline reminder
messages.body_text: Course registration closes on 2026-08-18 at 17:00. Submit appeals before the deadline if any required module is missing.

messages.subject: Lab onboarding documents
messages.body_text: Please review the attached lab safety guide and workstation policy before onboarding.
